title: Gemini doesn’t seem like it can do simple idle breathing animations for a character sprite sheet?
author: Alternative_Neck_860
selftext:
So my workflow so far is I generate a video using a reference image with Gemini, that plays the animation I need. Then, I pause the video every second or so and take screenshots of each frame I’ll need. This has worked before with animations that have lots of movement. 

But when I try to create just a simple idle breathing animation for a sprite sheet, the ai video always has the character moving around and doing a bunch of movement with their hands, etc, instead of just simply standing there and breathing while being still. 

  
Does anyone know how I can fix this?

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: Did you try describing what parts of the character is supposed to do in detail? if so depending on the art style you could try a JS/Cavas Workflow and do a similar screenshots to sprite image style or just use the assets as is depending in your stack/engine

comments.author: JustANerd420
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/yatk62qzcrxg1.jpeg?width=2048&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=c91ea28536a216cc3cd10c645b5551379bec8f31

This is used with Gemini. I had an issue where it would hallucinate images if I did more than one animation. Try to do one and tell it what you want to happen in the animation, you can break it down frame by frame and it should stick to that.

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: One frame at a time and lots of cleanup
